purpose: Teach: 包み/吐い/おとなしく/しあわせ/ややこしい/蚊/いじっ/となり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼から、可愛い包み、もらったの、ドキドキしちゃう、私。
lines.en: Aoi, my boyfriend gave me this cute little package, and I just… my heart won't stop racing.
lines.style: Tender, almost confessional. Slight breathlessness on the admission. Speaking as if sharing something she's been turning over in her mind. Soft attack, gentle trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。飲み会で、後輩、吐いちゃってさ、結構、大変だったよ、私たち。
lines.en: Yeah, well — at that drinking thing last week, one of the new staff got sick all over the place. It was pretty chaotic for us.
lines.style: Light, slightly self-deprecating laugh underneath. A little weary but not complaining. Casual, matter-of-fact tone. The warm eye-roll of someone used to handling the small disasters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 店内、お客様、おとなしく、静かに、お待ちくださっているわね、いつも。
lines.en: The customers in the café — they're always so patient and quiet, waiting so politely. Every time.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. Slightly wondering tone, as if noticing something she's grateful for. Quiet pause before the final thought. Not wistful, but genuinely appreciative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、しあわせそうな顔、見れて、私も、嬉しいわよ、葵としても。
lines.en: I like seeing you look that happy, Mei. It makes me happy too — as your friend, I mean.
lines.style: Genuine and direct, but with a small hesitation before the clarification. Warm throughout. The careful kindness of someone wanting to say something true without overstating it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼の家族関係、ややこしい感じで、ちょっと、心配なの、私。
lines.en: His family situation is pretty complicated, and I just… I worry about it sometimes.
lines.style: Quieter, more vulnerable. A small catch at the beginning. Speaking carefully, as if admitting a concern she's been sitting with. Soft throughout, letting the worry show without dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏のテラス、蚊取り線香、置こうかしらね、お客様、気になるよね。
lines.en: Actually, we should probably put out some mosquito coils on the terrace once summer hits. Customers have been mentioning the bugs.
lines.style: Practical and solution-focused. Matter-of-fact delivery, but warm — not bossy. Thinking out loud, inviting agreement. The tone of someone who notices what needs doing and mentions it gently.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、スマホをいじってる時間、長くなっちゃったわよ、私、自覚してる。
lines.en: I've noticed I've been spending way too much time on my phone lately. I'm aware of it, which somehow makes it worse.
lines.style: Self-aware wry laugh. A little sheepish. The tone of someone calling herself out before anyone else has to. Light but honest, with the slight frustration of recognizing something about yourself you can't quite fix yet.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店のとなりに、新しいベーカリー、できたよ、見に行こう、メイちゃん!
lines.en: Hey, did you see? There's a new bakery that opened right next door. We should go check it out together sometime!
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening. Genuine excitement that doesn't feel forced. Inviting, warm close. The tone of someone who sees something small and good and wants to share it with someone she cares about.
